messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: App works locally / Disconnects from server online
parts:
Hello Andrew,
This is more of a question for the shinyapps-users list.  That being said, I took a quick look at your application and couldn't get it to work locally as is, so I took out the suppressPackageStartupMessages code replacing it with straight library() calls for the various libraries and that made it run locally. When I tried deploying it on a separate server
I saw this stack trace:

05/06 13:23:08.153Listening on http://0.0.0.0:35858
05/06 13:24:03.231Warning: Error in : cannot allocate vector of size 1.6 Gb
05/06 13:24:03.282Stack trace (innermost first):
05/06 13:24:03.282 50: load
05/06 13:24:03.282 13: runApp
05/06 13:24:03.282 12: fn
05/06 13:24:03.282 11: doTryCatch
05/06 13:24:03.282 10: tryCatchOne
05/06 13:24:03.282 9: tryCatchList
05/06 13:24:03.282 8: tryCatch
05/06 13:24:03.282 7: connect$retry
05/06 13:24:03.283 6: eval
05/06 13:24:03.283 5: eval
05/06 13:24:03.283 4: eval
05/06 13:24:03.283 3: eval
05/06 13:24:03.283 2: eval.parent
05/06 13:24:03.283 1: local
05/06 13:24:03.283Error : cannot allocate vector of size 1.6 Gb

I see the same grey screen you see when I deploy it to shinyapps.io  and I tried it with a 4GB instance size.  I suspect that your code is allocating a lot more memory than what shinyapps.io can handle.  

-Tareef
